items.title: Meta Ads: $355.88 spend, 23 leads, $15.47 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Window 2026-08-15 to 2026-08-21 (widened from the standard yesterday-only pull to cover a gap since the last successful run on 2026-08-14). Flooring Problems Campaign is the only campaign delivering — $355.88 spend, 23 leads, $15.47 CPL, close to its prior 7-day baseline of $15.68 (2026-08-08 to 2026-08-14). Account is ACTIVE, no ads flagged, no delivery anomalies.

needs_attention: Gap coverage: the last successful meta-ads run was 2026-08-14 (covering data through 2026-08-13). Today's run widened to --days 7 (2026-08-15 to 2026-08-21, cap 7) to close as much of the gap as possible, but 2026-08-14 itself remains uncovered — it falls outside both the 7-day cap and the prior run's window and was never ingested.

Baseline methodology note: because the widened report window already spans 7 days, a standard trailing '--days 7 ending yesterday' baseline call would have exactly duplicated the report window. Instead pulled the 7 days immediately preceding the report window (2026-08-08 to 2026-08-14) as the CPL baseline for anomaly comparison — a deviation from the usual baseline invocation pattern, flagging in case this should be standardized.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads) — values matched the counted leads exactly in both windows (23 and 22 respectively), same pattern seen on 2026-08-13. Third occurrence now; still no discrepancy, but the script's lead-action set likely needs extending rather than continuing to hand-verify this each run.
